parts:
Hi all,

Is there any approach to compute predicted values for the response variable at the nodes of the mesh when there are covariates in the linear predictor and their values are unknown at the nodes?

Thank you in advance
Juanmi

messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] fitted values at nodes. SPDE model
parts:
No, like any prediction, you either need to know the covariate values, or build models for them.

Finn
